seo_title: Find Fellowships for International Students in USA
seo_description: Fellowships for international students in the USA with deadlines, award details, and eligibility to compare. Explore listings and apply on provider application paths.
intro: Trying to find USA fellowships for international students usually means sorting through mixed eligibility rules, study levels, and application expectations before you can decide where to apply. This filtered slice narrows the search to programs connected with international student status and graduate study, with listings that touch areas such as education, STEM, medicine, arts, community, and other academic paths. As you compare the rows below, expect variation in award amounts, deadline timing, essay requirements, and supporting materials. Some opportunities may be relatively straightforward, while others ask for more documentation or a more detailed application. If you want to browse and compare options for graduate-level study in the USA, this is a practical organized place to plan.
h1: Compare USA Fellowships for International Students
supporting: Use this list to compare more than just the title. Check how each fellowship describes eligibility, field of study, and study level, then read the requirement line closely to see whether essays or extra materials may be involved. Because deadlines differ by program and some dates may be approaching soon, it is smart to review timing early and open the provider application path before you shortlist anything. ScholarshipTop highlights available deadline and award details in a structured format so you can prioritize opportunities and plan your next step.

faq.question: How can I find fellowships for international students in the USA on this page?
faq.answer: Use this filtered view to explore USA fellowship listings that align with international-student and graduate-level tags. ScholarshipTop highlights available deadline and award details in a structured format so you can prioritize opportunities and plan your next step.

faq.question: Can I compare award amounts and deadlines across these fellowship listings?
faq.answer: Yes—these rows include deadline text, but dates vary by program, so there is no single deadline for the whole page. Award amounts also vary by listing, and not every row shows the same level of detail, so review the current amount and timing on the provider application path.

faq.question: Are these USA fellowships only for graduate students?
faq.answer: This filter slice is centered on graduate-level opportunities for international students in the USA. Some listings may show other study-level labels in the catalog, so check each program’s eligibility signals before you apply.

faq.question: Do all fellowships here require an essay?
faq.answer: No—requirements vary across the programs below. When a provider application path is available, ScholarshipTop includes it so you can move from shortlist to submission more easily.

faq.question: What subjects can I explore in this fellowship list?
faq.answer: You can browse a focused set of USA listings connected to categories and fields such as Education, STEM, Medicine, Arts, Community, business, engineering, English, and health professions. Use the catalog labels to narrow what you want to compare, then compare program fit on the structured listing detail.
